newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Farallon.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Farallon.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos downgraded Farallon Communications Inc to hold from buy.
-- Said company's reported fiscal second quarter loss of $0.04 a share fell below the analyst's forecast of a profit of $0.03.

-- Cited shortfalls in both of Farallon's two product divisions: Internet products and local area networking products. "We would revisit our rating once the company turns profitable and shows consistent sequential improvement in the Internet business," a UBS report said.
